name: record-spot-check
description: Record the principal's verdicts on a digest's spot check, e.g. '2 bad, that was a renewal notice' or '1 good 3 good'. Pass each number with good or bad exactly as the principal typed it in this message, and any reason they gave. Only for the principal's own reply. Tell the principal what was recorded and any skipped numbers. If it reports no matching spot check or an unknown number, ask the principal which action they mean. If a write fails, the error names what was recorded; resending only the failed numbers is safe.

inputs.verdicts: object[] (each { n: number, verdict: 'good' | 'bad', reason?: string }; at least one)

outputs.skipped: object[] (each { n, reason }; numbers that are no longer gradable actions, so not recorded)
